newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: REALISTIC 'FIRE AND BRIMSTONE' AT S.AFRICAN CHURCH.
newsitem.headline: REALISTIC 'FIRE AND BRIMSTONE' AT S.AFRICAN CHURCH.

text.p: South African churchgoers were treated to a realistic "fire and brimstone" service on Sunday when their Calvinist theologian accidentally set off a cannister of tearsmoke while animatedly preaching against sin.

Afrikaner Dominee Ferdi Gouws was expanding on the seriousness of sin during the children's service and was using several aerosol sprays as props, when he released the tearsmoke from a cannister, state radio reported.
The gas spread quickly through the Nederduitse Gereformeerde Kerk in Port Elizabeth's Kraggakamma suburb as the congregation rushed coughing and sneezing from the pews.
The embarrassed minister made his apologies, but the remainder of the service was marked by much coughing and spluttering.
